subject: pathology
title: Neuropathy, myopathy and neuromuscular junction disease

steps.tx: **Guillain-Barre syndrome** (post Campylobacter, ascending areflexic weakness with **albuminocytologic dissociation**, autonomic instability, Miller Fisher ophthalmoplegia with ataxia and areflexia) is treated by **IVIG or plasmapheresis** (steroids useless) with ICU ventilation watched; **CIDP** (chronic over 8 weeks, steroids with IVIG responsive) differs by tempo. **Diabetic neuropathy** (stocking glove sensory with autonomic dysfunction, duloxetine or gabapentinoids, foot care) is length dependent axonal; uraemic and alcoholic patterns mimic.
steps.say: Ascending areflexic weakness with high protein calm cells is GBS: IVIG, never steroids. Chronic over 8 weeks is CIDP.

steps.tx: **B12 deficiency** (**subacute combined degeneration**: dorsal with lateral columns, vibratory loss with spastic paraparesis and dementia, **hypersegmented neutrophils** with macroovalocytes, intrinsic factor antibodies in pernicious anaemia) is replaced intramuscularly urgently (folate alone worsens cords); copper deficiency mimics. **Leprosy neuritis** (cooler ulnar and peroneal, reversal steroids), vasculitic mononeuritis multiplex (diabetes, PAN, Churg-Strauss with asthma and eosinophils, nerve biopsy) and critical illness polyneuropathy complete patterns.
steps.say: Vibration lost with stiff legs and big red cells is B12 cords: inject urgently, folate alone harms. Cooler thick nerves are leprosy.

steps.tx: **Duchenne muscular dystrophy** (X linked **dystrophin** absent, **Gowers sign** rising, **calf pseudohypertrophy**, CK massively raised, cardiomyopathy with respiratory failure, **steroids** prolonging walk) differs from **Becker** (reduced dystrophin, milder, later wheelchair); exon skipping and gene therapy evolve. **Dermatomyositis** (**heliotrope** eyelids with **Gottron papules**, proximal weakness with dysphagia, **malignancy hunt**, Jo-1 with lung disease, steroids with steroid sparers) versus polymyositis (no rash, statins and HIV mimics) versus **inclusion body** (finger flexor with quadriceps sparing, treatment resistant) sort inflammatory.
steps.say: Gowers calves huge CK boys are Duchenne: steroids prolong steps. Heliotrope Gottron weakness hunts cancer: dermatomyositis.

vis.alt: A child demonstrating Gowers sign, using hands to stand, with an inset showing enlarged calves, characteristic of Duchenne muscular dystrophy.
vis.caption: Duchenne muscular dystrophy: Gowers sign and calf pseudohypertrophy

steps.tx: **Myasthenia gravis** (ocular ptosis with diplopia, fatigable bulbar weakness improving rest, **AChR antibodies**, MuSK seronegative, **thymoma** hunt, **edrophonium** transiently improving, **pyridostigmine** with steroids and thymectomy) worsens with beta blockers and aminoglycosides; crisis (cholinergic versus myasthenic by pupils and secretions) ventilates with IVIG or exchange. **Lambert-Eaton** (small cell lung, **facilitation** improving strength, **VGCC** antibodies, autonomic dryness) and **botulism** (descending paralysis with dilated pupils, canned foods and wounds, **antitoxin**) complete junctional maps.
steps.say: Drooping fatigable lids improving rest are myasthenia: pyridostigmine, hunt thymoma. Small cell strength improving on repeat is Lambert-Eaton.
